title: The dashboard is keyboard-first: a Cmd/Ctrl+K command palette, j/k over Work rows, g-prefix jumps, and a ? shortcut sheet
description: A real browser on the built dashboard: Cmd/Ctrl+K (and a visible button, so a phone can too) opens the command palette; typing an item key and Enter opens that item's page, and the palette also opens Master (whose title reads Master) and toggles the theme; j/k move a cursor through the Work rows and Enter opens the row under it; g m opens Master, g w returns to Work, g s opens Setup; ? shows the shortcut sheet and Esc closes it.

steps.name: palette, row navigation, jumps and the shortcut sheet
